placement: Affinity plus descent64, fixed and charged to every arm
teacher: Best of four independently seeded SRPT-start priority searches, 8192 proposals each
target: Cross-entropy choice among operations that are feasible in the current ready set along the teacher trajectory
serving: One static encoder pass followed by a small dynamic head at ready-set decisions; materialize and replay the resulting schedule
validation_bar: At least 5 percent mean gain over srpt:128 with full p95 decision time at or below 5 ms
claim_bar: At least 5 percent paired median gain over MP-OFF, hand-graph and srpt:128 with positive bootstrap lower bounds in a fresh live gate
stop: Do not train if teacher decisions are almost always singleton, state labels fail exact replay, or the oracle teacher has under 5 percent validation headroom
